repos.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
repos.summary_zh: Supervision 是 Roboflow 的开源 Python 计算机视觉库，专注提供可复用 CV 工具。它通过 Detections 对象实现多模型输出统一处理，支持标注可视化、跟踪计数、数据集管理和基准测试。模型无关设计集成主流框架，亮点在于高度可定制工具与高效数据流程，适用于实时视频分析与应用开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Supervision is Roboflow's open-source Python library for computer vision, providing reusable tools for building CV applications. It features a unified Detections object for integrating outputs from models like Ultralytics and Transformers, along with customizable annotators, object tracking, zone counting, dataset conversion between YOLO/COCO/Pascal VOC, and performance benchmarking. Model-agnostic by design, it emphasizes efficient post-processing and cross-framework compatibility, enabling developers to focus on real-time video analysis and application development.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: Admin Dashboard UI built with Shadcn and Vite.
repos.summary_zh: satnaing/shadcn-admin 是基于 Shadcn UI 和 Vite 构建的企业级管理后台 UI 组件库。提供 10+ 预置页面、响应式布局、亮暗主题切换及完善的 RTL 语言支持，深度优化可访问性。通过自定义 Shadcn 组件与 TanStack Router 集成，为开发者提供可直接复用的生产级界面解决方案，显著加速后台系统开发。
repos.summary_en: satnaing/shadcn-admin is a production-grade admin dashboard UI library built with Shadcn UI and Vite. It features 10+ pre-built pages, responsive layouts, light/dark themes, comprehensive RTL support, and deep accessibility optimization. By customizing Shadcn components and integrating TanStack Router, it delivers reusable, enterprise-ready UI solutions that dramatically accelerate backend development.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Pocket Flow 框架的 AI 代码库分析项目，能自动爬取 GitHub 仓库并构建知识库，通过识别核心抽象和交互关系，将复杂代码转化为适合新手的可视化教程。项目已生成 AutoGen、FastAPI、LangGraph 等热门框架的教程，并在 Hacker News 获得 900+ 赞。提供在线服务 code2tutorial.com，用户只需粘贴 GitHub 链接即可生成教程，极大降低了代码库的学习门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project uses the Pocket Flow LLM framework to automatically crawl GitHub repositories and build knowledge bases. It analyzes entire codebases to identify core abstractions and interactions, transforming complex code into beginner-friendly tutorials with visualizations. The system has generated tutorials for popular frameworks like AutoGen, FastAPI, and LangGraph, reaching Hacker News front page with 900+ upvotes. An online service at code2tutorial.com is now available, allowing users to simply paste a GitHub link to generate tutorials without installation.

repos.description: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

repos.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
repos.summary_zh: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
repos.summary_en: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

repos.description: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
repos.summary_zh: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

repos.description: An out‑of‑the‑box Next.js + Cloudflare full‑stack starter integrating Edge Runtime, D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, Analytics Engine hooks, and a complete CI/CD pipeline.一个开箱即用的 Next.js + Cloudflare 全栈项目模板，集成 Edge Runtime、D1 数据库、R2 存储和完整的 CI/CD 流程。
repos.summary_zh: 一个开箱即用的Next.js + Cloudflare全栈模板，专为边缘计算场景打造。基于vinext实现4倍构建加速和57%包体积缩减，深度集成D1数据库、R2存储、KV缓存和Analytics Engine。内置better-auth认证、next-intl国际化、Vitest测试和完整CI/CD流水线，提供生产级环境变量验证、结构化日志和自动化迁移验证。适用于需要高性能、低成本、全球部署的现代化Web应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Production-ready Next.js + Cloudflare full-stack starter for edge computing. Leverages vinext for 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles, deeply integrating D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, and Analytics Engine. Features better-auth authentication, next-intl i18n, Vitest testing, and complete CI/CD pipeline with production-grade environment validation, structured logging, and automated migration verification. Ideal for high-performance, low-cost, globally-deployed modern web applications.

repos.description: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
repos.summary_zh: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
repos.summary_en: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.
